glosses: absence (state of being absent or withdrawn)

examples.text: Ma mère est morte durant mon absence.
examples.en: My mother died during my absence.

examples.text: Il est venu me voir pendant mon absence.
examples.en: He came to see me during my absence.

examples.text: Après une longue absence, il est revenu.
examples.en: After a long absence he came back.

examples.text: Je connais la véritable raison de son absence.
examples.en: I know the real reason for his absence.
